observations: Blue manual air pump with a white T-shaped handle.
A black rubber hose with a red connector is attached to the pump.
The pump head features a metal valve stem.
The pump body has a label with text, but it is too blurry to read.

claims.evidence: Weight cannot be determined from a photo.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The pump may be non-functional or have a leaky valve.
risks.proof: A video showing the pump inflating a tire or a balloon.

risks.risk: The pump may be a generic or counterfeit brand.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the brand name and model on the label.

risks.risk: The hose or valve may be damaged or clogged.
risks.proof: A photo of the hose and valve head with a clear view of the connection.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the label on the pump to identify the brand and model.
Video of the pump in operation to confirm it works.
Photo of the hose and valve head to check for damage.
response.reason: The item is a standard manual air pump. While the brand is unconfirmed, it can be priced as a generic unit in its worst-case (non-functional) state until the seller provides proof of functionality and brand identity.
